def parse_config_file(path):
    cfg = {
        "exclude": [],
        "only": [],
        "unwrapExports": False,
        "js": {"workspaces": True, "tsConfigPaths": True},
        "python": {"excludeConditionalImports": False},
        "check": {
            "entrypoints": [],
            "allowCircularDependencies": False,
            "allow": {},
            "deny": {},
            "aliases": {}
        }
    }
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return cfg
    try:
        content = pathlib.Path(path).read_text()
    except:
        return cfg
    try:
        import yaml
        data = yaml.safe_load(content)
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            if "exclude" in data and isinstance(data["exclude"], list):
                cfg["exclude"] = data["exclude"]
            if "only" in data and isinstance(data["only"], list):
                cfg["only"] = data["only"]
            if "unwrapExports" in data:
                cfg["unwrapExports"] = bool(data["unwrapExports"])
            if "js" in data and isinstance(data["js"], dict):
                if "workspaces" in data["js"]:
                    cfg["js"]["workspaces"] = bool(data["js"]["workspaces"])
                if "tsConfigPaths" in data["js"]:
                    cfg["js"]["tsConfigPaths"] = bool(data["js"]["tsConfigPaths"])
            if "python" in data and isinstance(data["python"], dict):
                if "excludeConditionalImports" in data["python"]:
                    cfg["python"]["excludeConditionalImports"] = bool(data["python"]["excludeConditionalImports"])
            if "check" in data and isinstance(data["check"], dict):
                chk = data["check"]
                if "entrypoints" in chk and isinstance(chk["entrypoints"], list):
                    cfg["check"]["entrypoints"] = chk["entrypoints"]
                if "allowCircularDependencies" in chk:
                    cfg["check"]["allowCircularDependencies"] = bool(chk["allowCircularDependencies"])
                if "allow" in chk and isinstance(chk["allow"], dict):
                    allow_dict = {}
                    for k,v in chk["allow"].items():
                        if isinstance(v, list):
                            allow_dict[k] = v
                        elif isinstance(v, dict):
                            to_list = v.get("to", [])
                            if not isinstance(to_list, list):
                                to_list = [to_list]
                            allow_dict[k] = {"to": to_list, "reason": v.get("reason","")}
                        else:
                            allow_dict[k] = []
                    cfg["check"]["allow"] = allow_dict
                if "deny" in chk and isinstance(chk["deny"], dict):
                    deny_dict = {}
                    for k,v in chk["deny"].items():
                        if isinstance(v, list):
                            processed = []
                            for elem in v:
                                if isinstance(elem, str):
                                    processed.append(elem)
                                elif isinstance(elem, dict):
                                    processed.append({"to": elem.get("to",""), "reason": elem.get("reason","")})
                            deny_dict[k] = processed
                    cfg["check"]["deny"] = deny_dict
                if "aliases" in chk and isinstance(chk["aliases"], dict):
                    cfg["check"]["aliases"] = chk["aliases"]
        return cfg
    except Exception as e:
        pass
    # Fallback simple parsing
    m = re.search(r'exclude:\s*\n((?:\s*-\s*.*\n)+)', content)
    if m:
        block = m.group(1)
        items = re.findall(r'-\s*[\'"]?(.*?)[\'"]?\s*$', block, re.MULTILINE)
        cfg["exclude"] = [i.strip() for i in items if i.strip()]
    # only (top-level)
    # Find only that is not inside check (approx)
    # We'll parse line by line
    lines = content.splitlines()
    in_check = False
    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("check:"):
            in_check = True
        if not in_check and stripped.startswith("only:"):
            # Next lines that are indented and start with -
            j = idx+1
            while j < len(lines):
                l = lines[j]
                if re.match(r'\s*-\s*', l):
                    mm = re.search(r'-\s*[\'"]?(.*?)[\'"]?\s*$', l)
                    if mm:
                        cfg["only"].append(mm.group(1).strip())
                    j+=1
                elif l.strip() == "" or l.strip().startswith("#"):
                    j+=1
                else:
                    break
        if stripped.startswith("js:"):
            # Look ahead for workspaces and tsConfigPaths
            j = idx+1
            while j < len(lines) and (lines[j].startswith(" ") or lines[j].strip()==""):
                if "workspaces:" in lines[j]:
                    cfg["js"]["workspaces"] = "true" in lines[j]
                if "tsConfigPaths:" in lines[j]:
                    cfg["js"]["tsConfigPaths"] = "true" in lines[j]
                j+=1
        if stripped.startswith("python:"):
            j = idx+1
            while j < len(lines) and (lines[j].startswith(" ") or lines[j].strip()==""):
                if "excludeConditionalImports:" in lines[j]:
                    cfg["python"]["excludeConditionalImports"] = "true" in lines[j]
                j+=1
        if "unwrapExports:" in line:
            cfg["unwrapExports"] = "true" in line
    # check entrypoints inline or list
    m = re.search(r'entrypoints:\s*\[(.*?)\]', content)
    if m:
        inside = m.group(1)
        items = [s.strip().strip("'\"") for s in inside.split(",") if s.strip()]
        cfg["check"]["entrypoints"] = items
    else:
        # Look for entrypoints list under check
        in_check = False
        for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
            if line.strip().startswith("check:"):
                in_check = True
            if in_check and line.strip().startswith("entrypoints:"):
                j = idx+1
                eps = []
                while j < len(lines):
                    l = lines[j]
                    if re.match(r'\s*-\s*', l):
                        mm = re.search(r'-\s*[\'"]?(.*?)[\'"]?\s*$', l)
                        if mm:
                            eps.append(mm.group(1).strip())
                        j+=1
                    elif l.strip()=="":
                        j+=1
                    else:
                        break
                cfg["check"]["entrypoints"] = eps
                break
    if "allowCircularDependencies: true" in content:
        cfg["check"]["allowCircularDependencies"] = True
    if "allowCircularDependencies: false" in content:
        cfg["check"]["allowCircularDependencies"] = False
    return cfg

# Go graph builder for single file (tree)
def build_go_graph_single(entry_abs, only_patterns, exclude_patterns):
    go_mod, mod_root = find_go_mod(entry_abs)
    if go_mod is None:
        return None, None, None, f"no go.mod file found in any parent directory of {entry_abs}"
    module_name = parse_go_mod_module(go_mod)
    # Build maps
    import_to_files = {}
    dir_to_import = {}
    package_symbols = {}
    package_symbol_to_file = {}
    for root_dir, _, files in os.walk(mod_root):
        if 'vendor' in pathlib.Path(root_dir).parts:
            continue
        go_files = [os.path.join(root_dir, f) for f in files if f.endswith(".go")]
        if not go_files:
            continue
        rel = pathlib.Path(root_dir).relative_to(mod_root)
        if str(rel) == ".":
            imp_path = module_name
        else:
            imp_path = module_name + "/" + str(rel).replace(os.sep, "/")
        import_to_files[imp_path] = go_files
        dir_to_import[root_dir] = imp_path
        package_symbols[root_dir] = {}
        for gf in go_files:
            package_symbols[root_dir][gf] = parse_go_defined_symbols(gf)
        sym_to_file = {}
        for gf, syms in package_symbols[root_dir].items():
            for s in syms:
                if s not in sym_to_file:
                    sym_to_file[s] = gf
        package_symbol_to_file[root_dir] = sym_to_file

    def get_deps(file_abs):
        deps = set()
        file_abs = os.path.abspath(file_abs)
        file_dir = str(pathlib.Path(file_abs).parent)
        try:
            content = pathlib.Path(file_abs).read_text()
        except:
            return deps
        imports = parse_go_imports(file_abs)
        alias_to_import = {}
        for imp in imports:
            default_alias = imp.split("/")[-1]
            pat = re.compile(r'(\w+)\s+"%s"' % re.escape(imp))
            m = pat.search(content)
            if m:
                alias = m.group(1)
                if alias not in ("import","package","func","var","const","type"):
                    default_alias = alias
            alias_to_import[default_alias] = imp
        for alias, imp_path in alias_to_import.items():
            if not imp_path.startswith(module_name):
                continue
            target_files = import_to_files.get(imp_path)
            if not target_files:
                continue
            if alias == "_" or alias == ".":
                for tf in target_files:
                    deps.add(os.path.abspath(tf))
                continue
            usage_pat = re.compile(r'\b%s\.(\w+)\b' % re.escape(alias))
            for um in usage_pat.finditer(content):
                sym = um.group(1)
                target_dir = str(pathlib.Path(target_files[0]).parent) if target_files else None
                if not target_dir:
                    continue
                sym_to_file = package_symbol_to_file.get(target_dir, {})
                tf = sym_to_file.get(sym)
                if tf:
                    deps.add(os.path.abspath(tf))
                else:
                    for tf2 in target_files:
                        deps.add(os.path.abspath(tf2))
        # same-package
        files_in_same_dir = list(package_symbols.get(file_dir, {}).keys())
        if not files_in_same_dir:
            try:
                files_in_same_dir = [str(p) for p in pathlib.Path(file_dir).glob("*.go")]
            except:
                files_in_same_dir = []
        current_syms = package_symbols.get(file_dir, {}).get(file_abs, set())
        for other_f in files_in_same_dir:
            other_abs = os.path.abspath(other_f)
            if other_abs == os.path.abspath(file_abs):
                continue
            other_syms = package_symbols.get(file_dir, {}).get(other_abs, set())
            if not other_syms:
                continue
            for sym in other_syms:
                if sym in current_syms:
                    continue
                if re.search(r'\b%s\b' % re.escape(sym), content):
                    deps.add(other_abs)
                    break
        return deps

    circular_deps = []
    errors = {}

    def rel_path(p):
        try:
            return str(pathlib.Path(p).relative_to(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
        except:
            return os.path.basename(p)

    def build_recursive(cur_abs, stack):
        if cur_abs in stack:
            idx = stack.index(cur_abs)
            cycle = stack[idx:] + [cur_abs]
            rel_cycle = [rel_path(x) for x in cycle]
            circular_deps.append(rel_cycle)
            return None, True
        deps = get_deps(cur_abs)
        filtered = []
        for d in deps:
            rel_d = rel_path(d)
            if is_excluded(rel_d, exclude_patterns) or is_only_filtered(rel_d, only_patterns):
                continue
            filtered.append(d)
        if not filtered:
            return None, False
        subtree = {}
        for dep in filtered:
            if dep in stack:
                idx = stack.index(dep)
                cycle = stack[idx:] + [dep]
                rel_cycle = [rel_path(x) for x in cycle]
                circular_deps.append(rel_cycle)
                continue
            child_tree, _ = build_recursive(dep, stack + [cur_abs])
            rel_dep = rel_path(dep)
            subtree[rel_dep] = child_tree
        if not subtree:
            return None, False
        return subtree, False

    rel_entry = rel_path(os.path.abspath(entry_abs))
    sub, _ = build_recursive(os.path.abspath(entry_abs), [])
    tree = {rel_entry: sub}
    return tree, circular_deps, errors, None

def find_all_go_files_for_check(mod_root, module_name):
    import_to_files = {}
    package_symbols = {}
    package_symbol_to_file = {}
    for root_dir, _, files in os.walk(mod_root):
        if 'vendor' in pathlib.Path(root_dir).parts:
            continue
        go_files = [os.path.join(root_dir, f) for f in files if f.endswith(".go")]
        if not go_files:
            continue
        rel = pathlib.Path(root_dir).relative_to(mod_root)
        if str(rel) == ".":
            imp_path = module_name
        else:
            imp_path = module_name + "/" + str(rel).replace(os.sep, "/")
        import_to_files[imp_path] = go_files
        package_symbols[root_dir] = {}
        for gf in go_files:
            package_symbols[root_dir][gf] = parse_go_defined_symbols(gf)
        sym_to_file = {}
        for gf, syms in package_symbols[root_dir].items():
            for s in syms:
                if s not in sym_to_file:
                    sym_to_file[s] = gf
        package_symbol_to_file[root_dir] = sym_to_file
    return import_to_files, package_symbols, package_symbol_to_file

def main():
    args = sys.argv[1:]
    if not args:
        print_help(ROOT_HELP)
        sys.exit(0)
    if "-v" in args or "--version" in args:
        print("dep-tree version v0.23.4")
        sys.exit(0)

    subcommands = ["entropy","tree","check","explain","config","help"]

    # Find subcommand
    subcmd = None
    subcmd_idx = -1
    for idx, a in enumerate(args):
        if a.startswith("-"):
            continue
        if a in subcommands:
            subcmd = a
            subcmd_idx = idx
            break
        else:
            break

    if subcmd == "help":
        target = None
        for j in range(subcmd_idx+1, len(args)):
            a = args[j]
            if not a.startswith("-") and a in subcommands and a != "help":
                target = a
                break
        if target == "tree":
            print_help(TREE_HELP)
        elif target == "entropy":
            print_help(ENTROPY_HELP)
        elif target == "check":
            print_help(CHECK_HELP)
        elif target == "explain":
            print_help(EXPLAIN_HELP)
        elif target == "config":
            print_help(CONFIG_HELP)
        else:
            print_help(HELP_HELP)
        sys.exit(0)

    if "-h" in args or "--help" in args:
        if subcmd == "tree":
            print_help(TREE_HELP)

# Glob matching with doublestar
def glob_match(pattern, path):
    pattern = pattern.replace(os.sep, "/")
    path = path.replace(os.sep, "/")
    if pattern.startswith("./"):
        pattern = pattern[2:]
    if path.startswith("./"):
        path = path[2:]
    pat_segs = pattern.split("/") if pattern else []
    path_segs = path.split("/") if path else []

    def seg_match(pat_seg, path_seg):
        regex = ""
        i=0
        while i < len(pat_seg):
            c = pat_seg[i]
            if c == "*":
                regex += ".*"
            elif c == "?":
                regex += "."
            else:
                if c in ".^$+{}[]|()\\":
                    regex += "\\" + c
                else:
                    regex += c
            i+=1
        return re.fullmatch(regex, path_seg) is not None

    from functools import lru_cache
    @lru_cache(maxsize=None)
    def rec(i,j):
        if i == len(pat_segs) and j == len(path_segs):
            return True
        if i == len(pat_segs):
            return False
        if pat_segs[i] == "**":
            if i == len(pat_segs)-1:
                return True
            for k in range(j, len(path_segs)+1):
                if rec(i+1, k):
                    return True
            return False
        else:
            if j >= len(path_segs):
                return False
            if seg_match(pat_segs[i], path_segs[j]):
                return rec(i+1, j+1)
            else:
                return False
    return rec(0,0)

def match_any(patterns, path):
    if not patterns:
        return False
    for pat in patterns:
        if glob_match(pat, path):
            return True
    return False

def is_excluded(path, exclude_patterns):
    if not exclude_patterns:
        return False
    return match_any(exclude_patterns, path)

def is_only_filtered(path, only_patterns):
    if not only_patterns:
        return False
    return not match_any(only_patterns, path)

def find_file_upwards(start_dir, filename):
    p = pathlib.Path(start_dir).resolve()
    if p.is_file():
        p = p.parent
    for parent in [p] + list(p.parents):
        cand = parent / filename
        if cand.exists():
            return cand
    return None

def find_go_mod(start_path):
    p = pathlib.Path(start_path).resolve()
    if p.is_file():
        p = p.parent
    for parent in [p] + list(p.parents):
        go_mod = parent / "go.mod"
        if go_mod.exists():

    return None, None

            line=line.strip()
            if line.startswith("module "):
                parts = line.split()
                if len(parts) >= 2:
                    return parts[1]
    except:
        pass
    return None

def parse_go_imports(file_path):
    try:
        content = pathlib.Path(file_path).read_text()
    except:
        return []
    imports = []
    block_pattern = re.compile(r'import\s*\(\s*(.*?)\s*\)', re.DOTALL)
    for m in block_pattern.finditer(content):
        block = m.group(1)
        for im in re.finditer(r'"([^"]+)"', block):
            imports.append(im.group(1))
    content_no_blocks = block_pattern.sub('', content)
    single_pattern = re.compile(r'import\s+(?:[_\.\w]+\s+)?"([^"]+)"')
    for m in single_pattern.finditer(content_no_blocks):
        imp = m.group(1)
        if imp not in imports:
            imports.append(imp)
    return imports

def parse_go_package_name(file_path):
    try:
        content = pathlib.Path(file_path).read_text()
        m = re.search(r'^\s*package\s+(\w+)', content, re.MULTILINE)
        if m:
            return m.group(1)
    except:
        pass
    return None

def parse_go_defined_symbols(file_path):
    try:
        content = pathlib.Path(file_path).read_text()
    except:
        return set()
    syms = set()
    for m in re.finditer(r'func\s+(?:\([^)]+\)\s+)?(\w+)\s*\(', content):
        syms.add(m.group(1))
    for m in re.finditer(r'type\s+(\w+)\s+', content):
        syms.add(m.group(1))
    for m in re.finditer(r'(?:var|const)\s+(\w+)\b', content):
        syms.add(m.group(1))
    return syms

def parse_config_file(path):
    cfg = {
        "exclude": [],
        "only": [],
        "unwrapExports": False,
        "js": {"workspaces": True, "tsConfigPaths": True},
        "python": {"excludeConditionalImports": False},
        "check": {
            "entrypoints": [],
            "allowCircularDependencies": False,
            "allow": {},
            "deny": {},
            "aliases": {}
        }
    }
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return cfg
    try:
        content = pathlib.Path(path).read_text()
    except:
        return cfg
    try:
        import yaml
        data = yaml.safe_load(content)
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            if "exclude" in data and isinstance(data["exclude"], list):
                cfg["exclude"] = data["exclude"]
            if "only" in data and isinstance(data["only"], list):
                cfg["only"] = data["only"]
            if "unwrapExports" in data:
                cfg["unwrapExports"] = bool(data["unwrapExports"])
            if "js" in data and isinstance(data["js"], dict):
                if "workspaces" in data["js"]:
                    cfg["js"]["workspaces"] = bool(data["js"]["workspaces"])
                if "tsConfigPaths" in data["js"]:
                    cfg["js"]["tsConfigPaths"] = bool(data["js"]["tsConfigPaths"])
            if "python" in data and isinstance(data["python"], dict):
                if "excludeConditionalImports" in data["python"]:
                    cfg["python"]["excludeConditionalImports"] = bool(data["python"]["excludeConditionalImports"])
            if "check" in data and isinstance(data["check"], dict):
                chk = data["check"]
                if "entrypoints" in chk and isinstance(chk["entrypoints"], list):
                    cfg["check"]["entrypoints"] = chk["entrypoints"]
                if "allowCircularDependencies" in chk:
                    cfg["check"]["allowCircularDependencies"] = bool(chk["allowCircularDependencies"])
                if "allow" in chk and isinstance(chk["allow"], dict):
                    allow_dict = {}
                    for k,v in chk["allow"].items():
                        if isinstance(v, list):
                            allow_dict[k] = v
                        elif isinstance(v, dict):
                            to_list = v.get("to", [])
                            if not isinstance(to_list, list):
                                to_list = [to_list]
                            allow_dict[k] = {"to": to_list, "reason": v.get("reason","")}
                        else:
                            allow_dict[k] = []
                    cfg["check"]["allow"] = allow_dict
                if "deny" in chk and isinstance(chk["deny"], dict):
                    deny_dict = {}
                    for k,v in chk["deny"].items():
                        if isinstance(v, list):
                            processed = []
                            for elem in v:
                                if isinstance(elem, str):
                                    processed.append(elem)
                                elif isinstance(elem, dict):
                                    processed.append({"to": elem.get("to",""), "reason": elem.get("reason","")})
                            deny_dict[k] = processed
                    cfg["check"]["deny"] = deny_dict
                if "aliases" in chk and isinstance(chk["aliases"], dict):
                    cfg["check"]["aliases"] = chk["aliases"]
        return cfg
    except Exception as e:
        pass
    # Fallback simple parsing
    m = re.search(r'exclude:\s*\n((?:\s*-\s*.*\n)+)', content)
    if m:
        block = m.group(1)
        items = re.findall(r'-\s*[\'"]?(.*?)[\'"]?\s*$', block, re.MULTILINE)
        cfg["exclude"] = [i.strip() for i in items if i.strip()]
    # only (top-level)
    # Find only that is not inside check (approx)
    # We'll parse line by line
    lines = content.splitlines()
    in_check = False
    for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if stripped.startswith("check:"):
            in_check = True
        if not in_check and stripped.startswith("only:"):
            # Next lines that are indented and start with -
            j = idx+1
            while j < len(lines):
                l = lines[j]
                if re.match(r'\s*-\s*', l):
                    mm = re.search(r'-\s*[\'"]?(.*?)[\'"]?\s*$', l)
                    if mm:
                        cfg["only"].append(mm.group(1).strip())
                    j+=1
                elif l.strip() == "" or l.strip().startswith("#"):
                    j+=1
                else:
                    break
        if stripped.startswith("js:"):
            # Look ahead for workspaces and tsConfigPaths
            j = idx+1
            while j < len(lines) and (lines[j].startswith(" ") or lines[j].strip()==""):
                if "workspaces:" in lines[j]:
                    cfg["js"]["workspaces"] = "true" in lines[j]
                if "tsConfigPaths:" in lines[j]:
                    cfg["js"]["tsConfigPaths"] = "true" in lines[j]
                j+=1
        if stripped.startswith("python:"):
            j = idx+1
            while j < len(lines) and (lines[j].startswith(" ") or lines[j].strip()==""):
                if "excludeConditionalImports:" in lines[j]:
                    cfg["python"]["excludeConditionalImports"] = "true" in lines[j]
                j+=1
        if "unwrapExports:" in line:
            cfg["unwrapExports"] = "true" in line
    # check entrypoints inline or list
    m = re.search(r'entrypoints:\s*\[(.*?)\]', content)
    if m:
        inside = m.group(1)
        items = [s.strip().strip("'\"") for s in inside.split(",") if s.strip()]
        cfg["check"]["entrypoints"] = items
    else:
        # Look for entrypoints list under check
        in_check = False
        for idx, line in enumerate(lines):
            if line.strip().startswith("check:"):
                in_check = True
            if in_check and line.strip().startswith("entrypoints:"):
                j = idx+1
                eps = []
                while j < len(lines):
                    l = lines[j]
                    if re.match(r'\s*-\s*', l):
                        mm = re.search(r'-\s*[\'"]?(.*?)[\'"]?\s*$', l)
                        if mm:
                            eps.append(mm.group(1).strip())
                        j+=1
                    elif l.strip()=="":
                        j+=1
                    else:
                        break
                cfg["check"]["entrypoints"] = eps
                break
    if "allowCircularDependencies: true" in content:
        cfg["check"]["allowCircularDependencies"] = True
    if "allowCircularDependencies: false" in content:
        cfg["check"]["allowCircularDependencies"] = False
    return cfg

# Go graph builder for single file (tree)
def build_go_graph_single(entry_abs, only_patterns, exclude_patterns):
    go_mod, mod_root = find_go_mod(entry_abs)
    if go_mod is None:
        return None, None, None, f"no go.mod file found in any parent directory of {entry_abs}"
    module_name = parse_go_mod_module(go_mod)
    # Build maps
    import_to_files = {}
    dir_to_import = {}
    package_symbols = {}
    package_symbol_to_file = {}
    for root_dir, _, files in os.walk(mod_root):
        if 'vendor' in pathlib.Path(root_dir).parts:
            continue
        go_files = [os.path.join(root_dir, f) for f in files if f.endswith(".go")]
        if not go_files:
            continue
        rel = pathlib.Path(root_dir).relative_to(mod_root)
        if str(rel) == ".":
            imp_path = module_name
        else:
            imp_path = module_name + "/" + str(rel).replace(os.sep, "/")
        import_to_files[imp_path] = go_files
        dir_to_import[root_dir] = imp_path
        package_symbols[root_dir] = {}
        for gf in go_files:
            package_symbols[root_dir][gf] = parse_go_defined_symbols(gf)
        sym_to_file = {}
        for gf, syms in package_symbols[root_dir].items():
            for s in syms:
                if s not in sym_to_file:
                    sym_to_file[s] = gf
        package_symbol_to_file[root_dir] = sym_to_file

    def get_deps(file_abs):
        deps = set()
        file_abs = os.path.abspath(file_abs)
        file_dir = str(pathlib.Path(file_abs).parent)
        try:
            content = pathlib.Path(file_abs).read_text()
        except:
            return deps
        imports = parse_go_imports(file_abs)
        alias_to_import = {}
        for imp in imports:
            default_alias = imp.split("/")[-1]
            pat = re.compile(r'(\w+)\s+"%s"' % re.escape(imp))
            m = pat.search(content)
            if m:
                alias = m.group(1)
                if alias not in ("import","package","func","var","const","type"):
                    default_alias = alias
            alias_to_import[default_alias] = imp
        for alias, imp_path in alias_to_import.items():
            if not imp_path.startswith(module_name):
                continue
            target_files = import_to_files.get(imp_path)
            if not target_files:
                continue
            if alias == "_" or alias == ".":
                for tf in target_files:
                    deps.add(os.path.abspath(tf))
                continue
            usage_pat = re.compile(r'\b%s\.(\w+)\b' % re.escape(alias))
            for um in usage_pat.finditer(content):
                sym = um.group(1)
                target_dir = str(pathlib.Path(target_files[0]).parent) if target_files else None
                if not target_dir:
                    continue
                sym_to_file = package_symbol_to_file.get(target_dir, {})
                tf = sym_to_file.get(sym)
                if tf:
                    deps.add(os.path.abspath(tf))
                else:
                    for tf2 in target_files:
                        deps.add(os.path.abspath(tf2))
        # same-package
        files_in_same_dir = list(package_symbols.get(file_dir, {}).keys())
        if not files_in_same_dir:
            try:
                files_in_same_dir = [str(p) for p in pathlib.Path(file_dir).glob("*.go")]
            except:
                files_in_same_dir = []
        current_syms = package_symbols.get(file_dir, {}).get(file_abs, set())
        for other_f in files_in_same_dir:
            other_abs = os.path.abspath(other_f)
            if other_abs == os.path.abspath(file_abs):
                continue
            other_syms = package_symbols.get(file_dir, {}).get(other_abs, set())
            if not other_syms:
                continue
            for sym in other_syms:
                if sym in current_syms:
                    continue
                if re.search(r'\b%s\b' % re.escape(sym), content):
                    deps.add(other_abs)
                    break
        return deps

    circular_deps = []
    errors = {}

    def rel_path(p):
        try:
            return str(pathlib.Path(p).relative_to(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
        except:
            return os.path.basename(p)

    def build_recursive(cur_abs, stack):
        if cur_abs in stack:
            idx = stack.index(cur_abs)
            cycle = stack[idx:] + [cur_abs]
            rel_cycle = [rel_path(x) for x in cycle]
            circular_deps.append(rel_cycle)
            return None, True
        deps = get_deps(cur_abs)
        filtered = []
        for d in deps:
            rel_d = rel_path(d)
            if is_excluded(rel_d, exclude_patterns) or is_only_filtered(rel_d, only_patterns):
                continue
            filtered.append(d)
        if not filtered:
            return None, False
        subtree = {}
        for dep in filtered:
            if dep in stack:
                idx = stack.index(dep)
                cycle = stack[idx:] + [dep]
                rel_cycle = [rel_path(x) for x in cycle]
                circular_deps.append(rel_cycle)
                continue
            child_tree, _ = build_recursive(dep, stack + [cur_abs])
            rel_dep = rel_path(dep)
            subtree[rel_dep] = child_tree
        if not subtree:
            return None, False
        return subtree, False

    rel_entry = rel_path(os.path.abspath(entry_abs))
    sub, _ = build_recursive(os.path.abspath(entry_abs), [])
    tree = {rel_entry: sub}
    return tree, circular_deps, errors, None

def find_all_go_files_for_check(mod_root, module_name):
    import_to_files = {}
    package_symbols = {}
    package_symbol_to_file = {}
    for root_dir, _, files in os.walk(mod_root):
        if 'vendor' in pathlib.Path(root_dir).parts:
            continue
        go_files = [os.path.join(root_dir, f) for f in files if f.endswith(".go")]
        if not go_files:
            continue
        rel = pathlib.Path(root_dir).relative_to(mod_root)
        if str(rel) == ".":
            imp_path = module_name
        else:
            imp_path = module_name + "/" + str(rel).replace(os.sep, "/")
        import_to_files[imp_path] = go_files
        package_symbols[root_dir] = {}
        for gf in go_files:
            package_symbols[root_dir][gf] = parse_go_defined_symbols(gf)
        sym_to_file = {}
        for gf, syms in package_symbols[root_dir].items():
            for s in syms:
                if s not in sym_to_file:

        package_symbol_to_file[root_dir] = sym_to_file
    return import_to_files, package_symbols, package_symbol_to_file

    # Parse global flags
    config_path = ".dep-tree.yml"
    only_patterns = []
    exclude_patterns = []
    unwrap_exports = False
    js_tsconfig_paths = None
    js_workspaces = None
    python_exclude_conditional = None

    # For bool flags tracking if set
    js_tsconfig_set = False
    js_workspaces_set = False
    python_exclude_set = False
    unwrap_set = False

    args_without_global = []
    i=0
    while i < len(args):
        a = args[i]
        if a == "-c" or a == "--config":
            if i+1 < len(args):
                config_path = args[i+1]
                i+=2
            else:
                eprint(f"Error: flag needs an argument: '{a}'")
                sys.exit(1)
        elif a.startswith("--config="):
            config_path = a.split("=",1)[1]
            i+=1
        elif a.startswith("-c="):
            config_path = a.split("=",1)[1]
            i+=1
        elif a == "--only":
            if i+1 < len(args):
                only_patterns.append(args[i+1])
                i+=2
            else:
                eprint(f"Error: flag needs an argument: '{a}'")
                sys.exit(1)
        elif a.startswith("--only="):
            only_patterns.append(a.split("=",1)[1])
            i+=1
        elif a == "--exclude":
            if i+1 < len(args):
                exclude_patterns.append(args[i+1])
                i+=2
            else:
                eprint(f"Error: flag needs an argument: '{a}'")
                sys.exit(1)
        elif a.startswith("--exclude="):
            exclude_patterns.append(a.split("=",1)[1])
            i+=1
        elif a == "--unwrap-exports":
            unwrap_exports = True
            unwrap_set = True
            i+=1
        elif a.startswith("--unwrap-exports="):
            v = a.split("=",1)[1].lower()
            unwrap_exports = v in ("true","1","t")
            unwrap_set = True
            i+=1
        elif a == "--js-tsconfig-paths":
            js_tsconfig_paths = True
            js_tsconfig_set = True
            i+=1
        elif a.startswith("--js-tsconfig-paths="):
            v = a.split("=",1)[1].lower()
            js_tsconfig_paths = v not in ("false","0","f")
            js_tsconfig_set = True
            i+=1
        elif a == "--js-workspaces":
            js_workspaces = True
            js_workspaces_set = True
            i+=1
        elif a.startswith("--js-workspaces="):
            v = a.split("=",1)[1].lower()
            js_workspaces = v not in ("false","0","f")
            js_workspaces_set = True
            i+=1
        elif a == "--python-exclude-conditional-imports":
            python_exclude_conditional = True
            python_exclude_set = True
            i+=1
        elif a.startswith("--python-exclude-conditional-imports="):
            v = a.split("=",1)[1].lower()
            python_exclude_conditional = v not in ("false","0","f")
            python_exclude_set = True
            i+=1
        else:
            args_without_global.append(a)
            i+=1

    # Re-find subcommand in args_without_global
    subcmd = None
    subcmd_idx = -1
    for idx, a in enumerate(args_without_global):
        if a in subcommands:
            subcmd = a
            subcmd_idx = idx
            break
        elif not a.startswith("-"):
            break

    # Subcommand specific flags
    no_browser_open = False
    render_path = ""
    enable_gui = False
    json_output = False
    overlap_left = False
    overlap_right = False

    def parse_entropy_flags(lst):
        nonlocal no_browser_open, render_path, enable_gui
        positional = []
        j=0
        while j < len(lst):
            a = lst[j]
            if a == "--no-browser-open":
                no_browser_open = True
                j+=1
            elif a == "--enable-gui":
                enable_gui = True
                j+=1
            elif a == "--render-path":
                if j+1 < len(lst):
                    render_path = lst[j+1]
                    j+=2
                else:
                    eprint(f"Error: flag needs an argument: '{a}'")
                    sys.exit(1)
            elif a.startswith("--render-path="):
                render_path = a.split("=",1)[1]
                j+=1
            else:
                positional.append(a)
                j+=1
        return positional

    def parse_tree_flags(lst):
        nonlocal json_output
        positional = []
        j=0
        while j < len(lst):
            a = lst[j]
            if a == "--json":
                json_output = True
                j+=1
            else:
                positional.append(a)
                j+=1
        return positional

    def parse_explain_flags(lst):
        nonlocal overlap_left, overlap_right
        positional = []
        j=0
        while j < len(lst):
            a = lst[j]
            if a == "-l" or a == "--overlap-left":
                overlap_left = True
                j+=1
            elif a == "-r" or a == "--overlap-right":
                overlap_right = True
                j+=1
            else:
                positional.append(a)

    entrypoints = []
    if subcmd is None:
        entrypoints = parse_entropy_flags(args_without_global)
    elif subcmd == "entropy":
        rest = args_without_global[subcmd_idx+1:]
        entrypoints = parse_entropy_flags(rest)
    elif subcmd == "tree":
        rest = args_without_global[subcmd_idx+1:]
        entrypoints = parse_tree_flags(rest)

        # check has no positional, but we ignore
        entrypoints = []
    elif subcmd == "explain":
        rest = args_without_global[subcmd_idx+1:]
        entrypoints = parse_explain_flags(rest)
    elif subcmd == "config":
        entrypoints = []

    cfg = parse_config_file(config_path)

    merged_only = cfg.get("only", []) + only_patterns
    merged_exclude = cfg.get("exclude", []) + exclude_patterns

    # Resolve final bool flags: if set via CLI, use CLI, else config
    final_unwrap = unwrap_exports if unwrap_set else cfg.get("unwrapExports", False)

    final_py_ex = python_exclude_conditional if python_exclude_set else cfg.get("python", {}).get("excludeConditionalImports", False)

    # Handle config command
    if subcmd == "config":
        if os.path.exists(config_path):
            eprint(f"Error: cannot generate config file, as one already exists in {config_path}")
            sys.exit(1)
        else:
            with open(config_path, "w") as f:
                f.write(CONFIG_SAMPLE)
            sys.exit(0)

    if subcmd == "tree":
        if not entrypoints:
            eprint("Error: requires at least 1 arg(s), only received 0")
            sys.exit(1)
        expanded = []
        for ep in entrypoints:
            matches = globmod.glob(ep, recursive=True)
            if not matches:
                if os.path.exists(ep):
                    matches = [ep]
            if not matches:
                eprint(f"Error: {ep} does not match with any existing file")
                sys.exit(1)
            expanded.extend([m for m in matches if os.path.isfile(m)])
        # dedup
        seen=set()
        uniq=[]
        for p in expanded:
            if p not in seen:
                seen.add(p)
                uniq.append(p)
        expanded=uniq
        if not expanded:
            eprint(f"Error: {entrypoints[0]} does not match with any existing file")

        if overlap_right:

        sys.stderr.write("                                          \n")
        sys.stderr.write("\n⠋ (1/1) Finished loading (100 it/s) [0s] \n")

        for fr,to in results:

            except:

            try:

            except:
                to_rel = to

            to_pkg = parse_go_package_name(to) or "main"
            print(f"{from_pkg}@{from_rel} -> {to_pkg}@{to_rel}")

        sys.exit(0)

    sys.exit(1)

def glob_match(pattern, path):
    pattern = pattern.replace(os.sep, "/")
    path = path.replace(os.sep, "/")
    if pattern.startswith("./"):
        pattern = pattern[2:]
    if path.startswith("./"):
        path = path[2:]
    pat_segs = pattern.split("/") if pattern else []
    path_segs = path.split("/") if path else []
    def seg_match(pat_seg, path_seg):
        regex = ""
        i=0
        while i < len(pat_seg):
            c = pat_seg[i]
            if c == "*":
                regex += ".*"
            elif c == "?":
                regex += "."
            else:
                if c in ".^$+{}[]|()\\":
                    regex += "\\" + c
                else:
                    regex += c
            i+=1
        return re.fullmatch(regex, path_seg) is not None
    from functools import lru_cache
    @lru_cache(maxsize=None)
    def rec(i,j):
        if i == len(pat_segs) and j == len(path_segs):
            return True
        if i == len(pat_segs):
            return False
        if pat_segs[i] == "**":
            if i == len(pat_segs)-1:
                return True
            for k in range(j, len(path_segs)+1):
                if rec(i+1, k):
                    return True
            return False
        else:
            if j >= len(path_segs):
                return False
            if seg_match(pat_segs[i], path_segs[j]):
                return rec(i+1, j+1)
            else:
                return False
    return rec(0,0)

def match_any(patterns, path):
    if not patterns:
        return False
    for pat in patterns:
        if glob_match(pat, path):
            return True
    return False

def is_excluded(path, exclude_patterns):
    if not exclude_patterns:
        return False
    return match_any(exclude_patterns, path)

def is_only_filtered(path, only_patterns):
    if not only_patterns:
        return False
    return not match_any(only_patterns, path)

def find_file_upwards(start_dir, filename):
    p = pathlib.Path(start_dir).resolve()
    if p.is_file():
        p = p.parent
    for parent in [p] + list(p.parents):
        cand = parent / filename
        if cand.exists():
            return cand
    return None

def find_go_mod(start_path):
    p = pathlib.Path(start_path).resolve()
    if p.is_file():
        p = p.parent
    for parent in [p] + list(p.parents):
        go_mod = parent / "go.mod"
        if go_mod.exists():
            return go_mod, parent
    return None, None

def parse_go_mod_module(go_mod_path):
    try:
        content = go_mod_path.read_text()
        for line in content.splitlines():
            line=line.strip()
            if line.startswith("module "):
                parts = line.split()
                if len(parts) >= 2:
                    return parts[1]
    except:
        pass
    return None

def parse_go_imports(file_path):
    try:
        content = pathlib.Path(file_path).read_text()
    except:
        return []
    imports = []
    block_pattern = re.compile(r'import\s*\(\s*(.*?)\s*\)', re.DOTALL)
    for m in block_pattern.finditer(content):
        block = m.group(1)
        for im in re.finditer(r'"([^"]+)"', block):
            imports.append(im.group(1))
    content_no_blocks = block_pattern.sub('', content)
    single_pattern = re.compile(r'import\s+(?:[_\.\w]+\s+)?"([^"]+)"')
    for m in single_pattern.finditer(content_no_blocks):
        imp = m.group(1)
        if imp not in imports:
            imports.append(imp)
    return imports

def parse_go_package_name(file_path):
    try:
        content = pathlib.Path(file_path).read_text()
        m = re.search(r'^\s*package\s+(\w+)', content, re.MULTILINE)
        if m:
            return m.group(1)
    except:
        pass
    return None

def parse_go_defined_symbols(file_path):
    try:
        content = pathlib.Path(file_path).read_text()
    except:
        return set()
    syms = set()
    for m in re.finditer(r'func\s+(?:\([^)]+\)\s+)?(\w+)\s*\(', content):
        syms.add(m.group(1))
    for m in re.finditer(r'type\s+(\w+)\s+', content):
        syms.add(m.group(1))
    for m in re.finditer(r'(?:var|const)\s+(\w+)\b', content):
        syms.add(m.group(1))
    return syms

def parse_yaml_simple(content):
    lines = content.splitlines()
    cleaned = []
    for line in lines:
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
            continue
        in_single=False
        in_double=False
        idx=-1
        for i,ch in enumerate(line):
            if ch=="'" and not in_double:
                in_single=not in_single
            elif ch=='"' and not in_single:
                in_double=not in_double
            elif ch=='#' and not in_single and not in_double:
                idx=i
                break
        if idx!=-1:
            line=line[:idx]
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        cleaned.append(line)
    root={}
    stack=[(-1, root)]
    last_key_stack=[None]
    i=0
    while i < len(cleaned):
        line=cleaned[i]
        indent=len(line)-len(line.lstrip(' '))
        stripped=line.strip()
        while stack and stack[-1][0] >= indent:
            stack.pop()
            last_key_stack.pop()
        if not stack:
            raise ValueError("Invalid indent")
        parent_indent, parent_container = stack[-1]
        last_key = last_key_stack[-1]
        if stripped.startswith("- "):
            val_part=stripped[2:].strip()
            if isinstance(parent_container, dict):
                if last_key is None:
                    i+=1
                    continue
                if parent_container.get(last_key) is None:
                    parent_container[last_key]=[]
                if not isinstance(parent_container[last_key], list):
                    parent_container[last_key]=[parent_container[last_key]]
                target_list = parent_container[last_key]
                if ": " in val_part or (val_part.endswith(":") and not val_part.startswith("'") and not val_part.startswith('"')):
                    new_dict={}
                    target_list.append(new_dict)
                    stack.append((indent, new_dict))
                    last_key_stack.append(None)
                    if ":" in val_part:
                        k,v=val_part.split(":",1)
                        k=k.strip().strip("'\"")
                        v=v.strip()
                        if v:
                            if (v.startswith("'") and v.endswith("'")) or (v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"')):
                                v=v[1:-1]
                            if v.lower()=="true":
                                new_dict[k]=True
                            elif v.lower()=="false":
                                new_dict[k]=False
                            elif v.startswith("["):
                                inner=v[1:-1]
                                items=[s.strip().strip("'\"") for s in inner.split(",") if s.strip()]
                                new_dict[k]=items
                            else:
                                new_dict[k]=v
                        else:
                            if i+1 < len(cleaned):
                                next_line=cleaned[i+1]
                                next_indent=len(next_line)-len(next_line.lstrip(' '))
                                next_stripped=next_line.strip()
                                if next_indent>indent:
                                    if next_stripped.startswith("- "):
                                        new_dict[k]=[]
                                        stack.append((indent, new_dict[k]))
                                        last_key_stack.append(k)
                                    else:
                                        new_dict[k]={}
                                        stack.append((indent, new_dict[k]))
                                        last_key_stack.append(k)
                            last_key_stack[-1]=k
                else:
                    v=val_part
                    if (v.startswith("'") and v.endswith("'")) or (v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"')):
                        v=v[1:-1]
                    target_list.append(v)
            elif isinstance(parent_container, list):
                if ": " in val_part or val_part.endswith(":"):
                    new_dict={}
                    parent_container.append(new_dict)
                    stack.append((indent, new_dict))
                    last_key_stack.append(None)
                    if ":" in val_part:
                        k,v=val_part.split(":",1)
                        k=k.strip().strip("'\"")
                        v=v.strip()
                        if v:
                            if (v.startswith("'") and v.endswith("'")) or (v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"')):
                                v=v[1:-1]
                            if v.lower()=="true":
                                new_dict[k]=True
                            elif v.lower()=="false":
                                new_dict[k]=False
                            elif v.startswith("["):
                                inner=v[1:-1]
                                items=[s.strip().strip("'\"") for s in inner.split(",") if s.strip()]
                                new_dict[k]=items
                            else:
                                new_dict[k]=v
                        else:
                            if i+1 < len(cleaned):
                                next_line=cleaned[i+1]
                                next_indent=len(next_line)-len(next_line.lstrip(' '))
                                next_stripped=next_line.strip()
                                if next_indent>indent:
                                    if next_stripped.startswith("- "):
                                        new_dict[k]=[]
                                        stack.append((indent, new_dict[k]))
                                        last_key_stack.append(k)
                                    else:
                                        new_dict[k]={}
                                        stack.append((indent, new_dict[k]))
                                        last_key_stack.append(k)
                            last_key_stack[-1]=k
                else:
                    v=val_part
                    if (v.startswith("'") and v.endswith("'")) or (v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"')):
                        v=v[1:-1]
                    parent_container.append(v)
        else:
            if ":" in stripped:
                k,v=stripped.split(":",1)
                k=k.strip().strip("'\"")
                v=v.strip()
                if isinstance(parent_container, dict):
                    if not v:
                        if i+1 < len(cleaned):
                            next_line=cleaned[i+1]
                            next_indent=len(next_line)-len(next_line.lstrip(' '))
                            next_stripped=next_line.strip()
                            if next_indent>indent:
                                if next_stripped.startswith("- "):
                                    new_list=[]
                                    parent_container[k]=new_list
                                    stack.append((indent, new_list))
                                    last_key_stack.append(k)
                                else:
                                    new_dict={}
                                    parent_container[k]=new_dict
                                    stack.append((indent, new_dict))
                                    last_key_stack.append(k)
                            else:
                                parent_container[k]=None
                                last_key_stack[-1]=k
                        else:
                            parent_container[k]=None
                            last_key_stack[-1]=k
                        if stack and isinstance(stack[-1][1], dict):
                            last_key_stack[-1]=k
                        elif isinstance(parent_container, dict):
                            last_key_stack[-1]=k
                    else:
                        if v.startswith("["):
                            inner=v[1:-1]
                            items=[s.strip().strip("'\"") for s in inner.split(",") if s.strip()]
                            parent_container[k]=items
                        elif v.lower()=="true":
                            parent_container[k]=True
                        elif v.lower()=="false":
                            parent_container[k]=False
                        else:
                            if (v.startswith("'") and v.endswith("'")) or (v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"')):
                                v=v[1:-1]
                            parent_container[k]=v
                        last_key_stack[-1]=k
        i+=1
    return root

def parse_config_file(path):
    cfg = {
        "exclude": [],
        "only": [],
        "unwrapExports": False,
        "js": {"workspaces": True, "tsConfigPaths": True},
        "python": {"excludeConditionalImports": False},
        "check": {
            "entrypoints": [],
            "allowCircularDependencies": False,
            "allow": {},
            "deny": {},
            "aliases": {}
        }
    }
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return cfg
    try:
        content = pathlib.Path(path).read_text()
    except:
        return cfg
    try:
        import yaml
        data = yaml.safe_load(content)
        if isinstance(data, dict):
            if "exclude" in data and isinstance(data["exclude"], list):
                cfg["exclude"] = data["exclude"]
            if "only" in data and isinstance(data["only"], list):
                cfg["only"] = data["only"]
            if "unwrapExports" in data:
                cfg["unwrapExports"] = bool(data["unwrapExports"])
            if "js" in data and isinstance(data["js"], dict):
                if "workspaces" in data["js"]:
                    cfg["js"]["workspaces"] = bool(data["js"]["workspaces"])
                if "tsConfigPaths" in data["js"]:
                    cfg["js"]["tsConfigPaths"] = bool(data["js"]["tsConfigPaths"])
            if "python" in data and isinstance(data["python"], dict):
                if "excludeConditionalImports" in data["python"]:
                    cfg["python"]["excludeConditionalImports"] = bool(data["python"]["excludeConditionalImports"])
            if "check" in data and isinstance(data["check"], dict):
                chk = data["check"]
                if "entrypoints" in chk and isinstance(chk["entrypoints"], list):
                    cfg["check"]["entrypoints"] = chk["entrypoints"]
                if "allowCircularDependencies" in chk:
                    cfg["check"]["allowCircularDependencies"] = bool(chk["allowCircularDependencies"])
                if "allow" in chk and isinstance(chk["allow"], dict):
                    allow_dict = {}
                    for k,v in chk["allow"].items():
                        if isinstance(v, list):
                            allow_dict[k] = v
                        elif isinstance(v, dict):
                            to_list = v.get("to", [])
                            if not isinstance(to_list, list):
                                to_list = [to_list]
                            allow_dict[k] = {"to": to_list, "reason": v.get("reason","")}
                        else:
                            allow_dict[k] = []
                    cfg["check"]["allow"] = allow_dict
                if "deny" in chk and isinstance(chk["deny"], dict):
                    deny_dict = {}
                    for k,v in chk["deny"].items():
                        if isinstance(v, list):
                            processed = []
                            for elem in v:
                                if isinstance(elem, str):
                                    processed.append(elem)
                                elif isinstance(elem, dict):
                                    processed.append({"to": elem.get("to",""), "reason": elem.get("reason","")})
                            deny_dict[k] = processed
                    cfg["check"]["deny"] = deny_dict
                if "aliases" in chk and isinstance(chk["aliases"], dict):
                    cfg["check"]["aliases"] = chk["aliases"]
        return cfg
    except:
        pass
    try:
        data = parse_yaml_simple(content)
        if "exclude" in data and isinstance(data["exclude"], list):
            cfg["exclude"] = data["exclude"]
        if "only" in data and isinstance(data["only"], list):
            cfg["only"] = data["only"]
        if "unwrapExports" in data:
            cfg["unwrapExports"] = bool(data["unwrapExports"])
        if "js" in data and isinstance(data["js"], dict):
            if "workspaces" in data["js"]:
                cfg["js"]["workspaces"] = bool(data["js"]["workspaces"])
            if "tsConfigPaths" in data["js"]:
                cfg["js"]["tsConfigPaths"] = bool(data["js"]["tsConfigPaths"])
        if "python" in data and isinstance(data["python"], dict):
            if "excludeConditionalImports" in data["python"]:
                cfg["python"]["excludeConditionalImports"] = bool(data["python"]["excludeConditionalImports"])
        if "check" in data and isinstance(data["check"], dict):
            chk = data["check"]
            if "entrypoints" in chk:
                if isinstance(chk["entrypoints"], list):
                    cfg["check"]["entrypoints"] = chk["entrypoints"]
            if "allowCircularDependencies" in chk:
                cfg["check"]["allowCircularDependencies"] = bool(chk["allowCircularDependencies"])
            if "allow" in chk and isinstance(chk["allow"], dict):
                cfg["check"]["allow"] = chk["allow"]
            if "deny" in chk and isinstance(chk["deny"], dict):
                cfg["check"]["deny"] = chk["deny"]
            if "aliases" in chk and isinstance(chk["aliases"], dict):
                cfg["check"]["aliases"] = chk["aliases"]
    except:
        pass
    return cfg

def build_go_graph_single(entry_abs, only_patterns, exclude_patterns):
    go_mod, mod_root = find_go_mod(entry_abs)
    if go_mod is None:
        return None, None, None, f"no go.mod file found in any parent directory of {entry_abs}"
    module_name = parse_go_mod_module(go_mod)
    import_to_files = {}
    package_symbols = {}
    package_symbol_to_file = {}
    for root_dir, _, files in os.walk(mod_root):
        if 'vendor' in pathlib.Path(root_dir).parts:
            continue
        go_files = [os.path.join(root_dir, f) for f in files if f.endswith(".go")]
        if not go_files:
            continue
        rel = pathlib.Path(root_dir).relative_to(mod_root)
        if str(rel) == ".":
            imp_path = module_name
        else:
            imp_path = module_name + "/" + str(rel).replace(os.sep, "/")
        import_to_files[imp_path] = go_files
        package_symbols[root_dir] = {}
        for gf in go_files:
            package_symbols[root_dir][gf] = parse_go_defined_symbols(gf)
        sym_to_file = {}
        for gf, syms in package_symbols[root_dir].items():
            for s in syms:
                if s not in sym_to_file:
                    sym_to_file[s] = gf
        package_symbol_to_file[root_dir] = sym_to_file

    def get_deps(file_abs):
        deps = set()
        file_abs = os.path.abspath(file_abs)
        file_dir = str(pathlib.Path(file_abs).parent)
        try:
            content = pathlib.Path(file_abs).read_text()
        except:
            return deps
        imports = parse_go_imports(file_abs)
        alias_to_import = {}
        for imp in imports:
            default_alias = imp.split("/")[-1]
            pat = re.compile(r'(\w+)\s+"%s"' % re.escape(imp))
            m = pat.search(content)
            if m:
                alias = m.group(1)
                if alias not in ("import","package","func","var","const","type"):
                    default_alias = alias
            alias_to_import[default_alias] = imp
        for alias, imp_path in alias_to_import.items():
            if not imp_path.startswith(module_name):
                continue
            target_files = import_to_files.get(imp_path)
            if not target_files:
                continue
            if alias == "_" or alias == ".":
                for tf in target_files:
                    deps.add(os.path.abspath(tf))
                continue
            usage_pat = re.compile(r'\b%s\.(\w+)\b' % re.escape(alias))
            for um in usage_pat.finditer(content):
                sym = um.group(1)
                target_dir = str(pathlib.Path(target_files[0]).parent) if target_files else None
                if not target_dir:
                    continue
                sym_to_file = package_symbol_to_file.get(target_dir, {})
                tf = sym_to_file.get(sym)
                if tf:
                    deps.add(os.path.abspath(tf))
                else:
                    for tf2 in target_files:
                        deps.add(os.path.abspath(tf2))
        files_in_same_dir = list(package_symbols.get(file_dir, {}).keys())
        if not files_in_same_dir:
            try:
                files_in_same_dir = [str(p) for p in pathlib.Path(file_dir).glob("*.go")]
            except:
                files_in_same_dir = []
        current_syms = package_symbols.get(file_dir, {}).get(file_abs, set())
        for other_f in files_in_same_dir:
            other_abs = os.path.abspath(other_f)
            if other_abs == os.path.abspath(file_abs):
                continue
            other_syms = package_symbols.get(file_dir, {}).get(other_abs, set())
            if not other_syms:
                continue
            for sym in other_syms:
                if sym in current_syms:
                    continue
                if re.search(r'\b%s\b' % re.escape(sym), content):
                    deps.add(other_abs)
                    break
        return deps

    circular_deps = []
    errors = {}
    def rel_path(p):
        try:
            return str(pathlib.Path(p).relative_to(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
        except:
            return os.path.basename(p)
    def build_recursive(cur_abs, stack):
        if cur_abs in stack:
            idx = stack.index(cur_abs)
            cycle = stack[idx:] + [cur_abs]
            rel_cycle = [rel_path(x) for x in cycle]
            circular_deps.append(rel_cycle)
            return None, True
        deps = get_deps(cur_abs)
        filtered = []
        for d in deps:
            rel_d = rel_path(d)
            if is_excluded(rel_d, exclude_patterns) or is_only_filtered(rel_d, only_patterns):
                continue
            filtered.append(d)
        if not filtered:
            return None, False
        subtree = {}
        for dep in filtered:
            if dep in stack:
                idx = stack.index(dep)
                cycle = stack[idx:] + [dep]
                rel_cycle = [rel_path(x) for x in cycle]
                circular_deps.append(rel_cycle)

def glob_match(pattern, path):
    pattern = pattern.replace(os.sep, "/")
    path = path.replace(os.sep, "/")
    if pattern.startswith("./"):
        pattern = pattern[2:]
    if path.startswith("./"):
        path = path[2:]
    pat_segs = pattern.split("/") if pattern else []
    path_segs = path.split("/") if path else []
    def seg_match(pat_seg, path_seg):
        regex = ""
        i=0
        while i < len(pat_seg):
            c = pat_seg[i]
            if c == "*":
                regex += ".*"
            elif c == "?":
                regex += "."
            else:
                if c in ".^$+{}[]|()\\":
                    regex += "\\" + c
                else:
                    regex += c
            i+=1
        return re.fullmatch(regex, path_seg) is not None
    from functools import lru_cache
    @lru_cache(maxsize=None)
    def rec(i,j):
        if i == len(pat_segs) and j == len(path_segs):
            return True
        if i == len(pat_segs):
            return False
        if pat_segs[i] == "**":
            if i == len(pat_segs)-1:
                return True
            for k in range(j, len(path_segs)+1):
                if rec(i+1, k):
                    return True
            return False
        else:
            if j >= len(path_segs):
                return False
            if seg_match(pat_segs[i], path_segs[j]):
                return rec(i+1, j+1)
            else:
                return False
    return rec(0,0)

def match_any(patterns, path):
    if not patterns:
        return False
    for pat in patterns:
        if glob_match(pat, path):
            return True
    return False

def is_excluded(path, exclude_patterns):
    if not exclude_patterns:
        return False
    return match_any(exclude_patterns, path)

def is_only_filtered(path, only_patterns):
    if not only_patterns:
        return False
    return not match_any(only_patterns, path)

def find_file_upwards(start_dir, filename):
    p = pathlib.Path(start_dir).resolve()
    if p.is_file():
        p = p.parent
    for parent in [p] + list(p.parents):
        cand = parent / filename
        if cand.exists():
            return cand
    return None

def find_go_mod(start_path):
    p = pathlib.Path(start_path).resolve()
    if p.is_file():
        p = p.parent
    for parent in [p] + list(p.parents):
        go_mod = parent / "go.mod"
        if go_mod.exists():
            return go_mod, parent
    return None, None

def parse_go_mod_module(go_mod_path):
    try:
        content = go_mod_path.read_text()
        for line in content.splitlines():
            line=line.strip()
            if line.startswith("module "):
                parts = line.split()
                if len(parts) >= 2:
                    return parts[1]
    except:
        pass
    return None

def parse_go_imports(file_path):
    try:
        content = pathlib.Path(file_path).read_text()
    except:
        return []
    imports = []
    block_pattern = re.compile(r'import\s*\(\s*(.*?)\s*\)', re.DOTALL)
    for m in block_pattern.finditer(content):
        block = m.group(1)
        for im in re.finditer(r'"([^"]+)"', block):
            imports.append(im.group(1))
    content_no_blocks = block_pattern.sub('', content)
    single_pattern = re.compile(r'import\s+(?:[_\.\w]+\s+)?"([^"]+)"')
    for m in single_pattern.finditer(content_no_blocks):
        imp = m.group(1)
        if imp not in imports:
            imports.append(imp)
    return imports

def parse_go_package_name(file_path):
    try:
        content = pathlib.Path(file_path).read_text()
        m = re.search(r'^\s*package\s+(\w+)', content, re.MULTILINE)
        if m:
            return m.group(1)
    except:
        pass
    return None

def parse_go_defined_symbols(file_path):
    try:
        content = pathlib.Path(file_path).read_text()
    except:
        return set()
    syms = set()
    for m in re.finditer(r'func\s+(?:\([^)]+\)\s+)?(\w+)\s*\(', content):
        syms.add(m.group(1))
    for m in re.finditer(r'type\s+(\w+)\s+', content):
        syms.add(m.group(1))
    for m in re.finditer(r'(?:var|const)\s+(\w+)\b', content):
        syms.add(m.group(1))
    return syms

def parse_yaml_simple(content):
    lines = content.splitlines()
    cleaned = []
    for line in lines:
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
            continue
        in_single=False
        in_double=False
        idx=-1
        for i,ch in enumerate(line):
            if ch=="'" and not in_double:
                in_single=not in_single
            elif ch=='"' and not in_single:
                in_double=not in_double
            elif ch=='#' and not in_single and not in_double:
                idx=i
                break
        if idx!=-1:
            line=line[:idx]
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        cleaned.append(line)
    root={}
    stack=[(-1, root)]
    last_key_stack=[None]
    i=0
    while i < len(cleaned):
        line=cleaned[i]
        indent=len(line)-len(line.lstrip(' '))
        stripped=line.strip()
        while stack and stack[-1][0] >= indent:
            stack.pop()
            last_key_stack.pop()
        if not stack:
            raise ValueError("Invalid indent")
        parent_indent, parent_container = stack[-1]
        last_key = last_key_stack[-1]
        if stripped.startswith("- "):
            val_part=stripped[2:].strip()
            if isinstance(parent_container, dict):
                if last_key is None:
                    i+=1
                    continue
                if parent_container.get(last_key) is None:
                    parent_container[last_key]=[]
                if not isinstance(parent_container[last_key], list):
                    parent_container[last_key]=[parent_container[last_key]]
                target_list = parent_container[last_key]
                if ": " in val_part or (val_part.endswith(":") and not val_part.startswith("'") and not val_part.startswith('"')):
                    new_dict={}
                    target_list.append(new_dict)
                    stack.append((indent, new_dict))
                    last_key_stack.append(None)
                    if ":" in val_part:
                        k,v=val_part.split(":",1)
                        k=k.strip().strip("'\"")
                        v=v.strip()
                        if v:
                            if (v.startswith("'") and v.endswith("'")) or (v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"')):
                                v=v[1:-1]
                            if v.lower()=="true":
                                new_dict[k]=True
                            elif v.lower()=="false":
                                new_dict[k]=False
                            elif v.startswith("["):
                                inner=v[1:-1]
                                items=[s.strip().strip("'\"") for s in inner.split(",") if s.strip()]
                                new_dict[k]=items
                            else:
                                new_dict[k]=v
                        else:
                            if i+1 < len(cleaned):
                                next_line=cleaned[i+1]
                                next_indent=len(next_line)-len(next_line.lstrip(' '))
                                next_stripped=next_line.strip()
                                if next_indent>indent:
                                    if next_stripped.startswith("- "):
                                        new_dict[k]=[]
                                        stack.append((indent, new_dict[k]))
                                        last_key_stack.append(k)
                                    else:
                                        new_dict[k]={}
                                        stack.append((indent, new_dict[k]))
                                        last_key_stack.append(k)
                            last_key_stack[-1]=k
                else:
                    v=val_part
                    if (v.startswith("'") and v.endswith("'")) or (v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"')):
                        v=v[1:-1]
                    target_list.append(v)
            elif isinstance(parent_container, list):
                if ": " in val_part or val_part.endswith(":"):
                    new_dict={}
                    parent_container.append(new_dict)
                    stack.append((indent, new_dict))
                    last_key_stack.append(None)
                    if ":" in val_part:
                        k,v=val_part.split(":",1)
                        k=k.strip().strip("'\"")
                        v=v.strip()
                        if v:
                            if (v.startswith("'") and v.endswith("'")) or (v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"')):
                                v=v[1:-1]

                            elif v.startswith("["):
                                inner=v[1:-1]
                                items=[s.strip().strip("'\"") for s in inner.split(",") if s.strip()]
                                new_dict[k]=items
                            else:
                                new_dict[k]=v
                        else:
                            if i+1 < len(cleaned):
                                next_line=cleaned[i+1]
                                next_indent=len(next_line)-len(next_line.lstrip(' '))
                                next_stripped=next_line.strip()
                                if next_indent>indent:
                                    if next_stripped.startswith("- "):
                                        new_dict[k]=[]
                                        stack.append((indent, new_dict[k]))
                                        last_key_stack.append(k)
                                    else:
                                        new_dict[k]={}
                                        stack.append((indent, new_dict[k]))
                                        last_key_stack.append(k)
                            last_key_stack[-1]=k
                else:
                    v=val_part
                    if (v.startswith("'") and v.endswith("'")) or (v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"')):
                        v=v[1:-1]
                    parent_container.append(v)
        else:
            if ":" in stripped:
                k,v=stripped.split(":",1)
                k=k.strip().strip("'\"")
                v=v.strip()
                if isinstance(parent_container, dict):
                    if not v:
                        if i+1 < len(cleaned):

                            if next_indent>indent:

                            else:
                                parent_container[k]=None

                        else:
                            parent_container[k]=None

    return root
