def build_go_graph_single(entry_abs, only_patterns, exclude_patterns):
    go_mod, mod_root = find_go_mod(entry_abs)
    if go_mod is None:
        return None, None, None, f"no go.mod file found in any parent directory of {entry_abs}"
    module_name = parse_go_mod_module(go_mod)
    import_to_files = {}
    package_symbols = {}
    package_symbol_to_file = {}
    for root_dir, _, files in os.walk(mod_root):
        if 'vendor' in pathlib.Path(root_dir).parts:
            continue
        go_files = [os.path.join(root_dir, f) for f in files if f.endswith(".go")]
        if not go_files:
            continue
        rel = pathlib.Path(root_dir).relative_to(mod_root)
        if str(rel) == ".":
            imp_path = module_name
        else:
            imp_path = module_name + "/" + str(rel).replace(os.sep, "/")
        import_to_files[imp_path] = go_files
        package_symbols[root_dir] = {}
        for gf in go_files:
            package_symbols[root_dir][gf] = parse_go_defined_symbols(gf)
        sym_to_file = {}
        for gf, syms in package_symbols[root_dir].items():
            for s in syms:
                if s not in sym_to_file:
                    sym_to_file[s] = gf
        package_symbol_to_file[root_dir] = sym_to_file

    def get_deps(file_abs):
        deps = set()
        file_abs = os.path.abspath(file_abs)
        file_dir = str(pathlib.Path(file_abs).parent)
        try:
            content = pathlib.Path(file_abs).read_text()
        except:
            return deps
        imports = parse_go_imports(file_abs)
        alias_to_import = {}
        for imp in imports:
            default_alias = imp.split("/")[-1]
            pat = re.compile(r'(\w+)\s+"%s"' % re.escape(imp))
            m = pat.search(content)
            if m:
                alias = m.group(1)
                if alias not in ("import","package","func","var","const","type"):
                    default_alias = alias
            alias_to_import[default_alias] = imp
        for alias, imp_path in alias_to_import.items():
            if not imp_path.startswith(module_name):
                continue
            target_files = import_to_files.get(imp_path)
            if not target_files:
                continue
            if alias == "_" or alias == ".":
                for tf in target_files:
                    deps.add(os.path.abspath(tf))
                continue
            usage_pat = re.compile(r'\b%s\.(\w+)\b' % re.escape(alias))
            for um in usage_pat.finditer(content):
                sym = um.group(1)
                target_dir = str(pathlib.Path(target_files[0]).parent) if target_files else None
                if not target_dir:
                    continue
                sym_to_file = package_symbol_to_file.get(target_dir, {})
                tf = sym_to_file.get(sym)
                if tf:
                    deps.add(os.path.abspath(tf))
                else:
                    for tf2 in target_files:
                        deps.add(os.path.abspath(tf2))
        files_in_same_dir = list(package_symbols.get(file_dir, {}).keys())
        if not files_in_same_dir:
            try:
                files_in_same_dir = [str(p) for p in pathlib.Path(file_dir).glob("*.go")]
            except:
                files_in_same_dir = []
        current_syms = package_symbols.get(file_dir, {}).get(file_abs, set())
        for other_f in files_in_same_dir:
            other_abs = os.path.abspath(other_f)
            if other_abs == os.path.abspath(file_abs):
                continue
            other_syms = package_symbols.get(file_dir, {}).get(other_abs, set())
            if not other_syms:
                continue
            for sym in other_syms:
                if sym in current_syms:
                    continue
                if re.search(r'\b%s\b' % re.escape(sym), content):
                    deps.add(other_abs)
                    break
        return deps

    circular_deps = []
    errors = {}
    def rel_path(p):
        try:
            return str(pathlib.Path(p).relative_to(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
        except:
            return os.path.basename(p)
    def build_recursive(cur_abs, stack):
        if cur_abs in stack:
            idx = stack.index(cur_abs)
            cycle = stack[idx:] + [cur_abs]
            rel_cycle = [rel_path(x) for x in cycle]
            circular_deps.append(rel_cycle)
            return None, True
        deps = get_deps(cur_abs)
        filtered = []
        for d in deps:
            rel_d = rel_path(d)
            if is_excluded(rel_d, exclude_patterns) or is_only_filtered(rel_d, only_patterns):
                continue
            filtered.append(d)
        if not filtered:
            return None, False
        subtree = {}
        for dep in filtered:
            if dep in stack:
                idx = stack.index(dep)
                cycle = stack[idx:] + [dep]
                rel_cycle = [rel_path(x) for x in cycle]
                circular_deps.append(rel_cycle)
                continue
            child_tree, _ = build_recursive(dep, stack + [cur_abs])
            rel_dep = rel_path(dep)
            subtree[rel_dep] = child_tree
        if not subtree:
            return None, False
        return subtree, False

    rel_entry = rel_path(os.path.abspath(entry_abs))
    sub, _ = build_recursive(os.path.abspath(entry_abs), [])
    tree = {rel_entry: sub}
    return tree, circular_deps, errors, None
